what_happened.line: The Finance Committee heard FY20 budget requests from the fire chief, with discussion of paramedic training, a new firefighter's overtime and a grant for breathing apparatus.
The police chief presented a budget with a request above the target figure, including detail/overtime software that was bought this year from equipment maintenance.
The board of health asked to open the health office on Thursdays.
The town manager reported the dispatch assessment came in slightly above the preliminary estimate and that the town's health insurance number decreased.
No budget votes were taken; the only vote was to adjourn.

why_it_matters: These are requests, not decisions: fire, police and health asks all feed the FY20 town budget, which is mostly taxes, and Town Meeting will be asked to vote on the final figures.
The paramedic question, whether to train current firefighters or pay other services for intercepts, is a long-term staffing and overtime cost that residents raised and that is still unresolved.
